entries.message: This update gives each added user their own scheduled sync and shared Plex Now Playing, adds Server Logs controls, and stops large Emby and Jellyfin watched imports timing out.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Added users now get their own scheduled sync and queued-job processing.
Feature: Shared Plex playback now shows in the matching user's Now Playing, while each user's credentials and history stay separate.
Feature: Server Logs can pause live updates, follow the newest entries and filter by text, and keep your reading position during refreshes.
Fix: The initial watched-status import from Emby and Jellyfin now reads played history in pages of 500, so a large watch history no longer fails with "Upstream request timed out after 10000ms".
Fix: Anonymous Plex owner-ID sessions are now ignored, and the same Plex account can no longer be connected twice.
Fix: Completed playback is recorded through the existing tracker intent, so an interrupted run can no longer create competing tracker writes.
Fix: Same-title shows with conflicting provider identities are now kept separate in Stats.
Fix: AniDB anime descriptions no longer keep partial HTML tag fragments after markup is stripped.
Tweak: Watched-history reads no longer request artwork from Emby and Jellyfin, so third-party image plugins cannot slow them down.
Tweak: Historical Simkl baseline evidence no longer shows as a persistent warning, and tracker reviews show a compact title, watch date and history buttons.
Tweak: Idle playback checks now run every 5 minutes (every 10 seconds once playback is detected), and setup help explains how plugins or webhooks give prompt updates.
Tweak: README screenshots now show the current v2.2.0 interface, including a dashboard image without loading placeholders.
